title: Kusoma kwa Ufasaha (Theme 3: Mapambo)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 5 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child names the features of fluent reading and judges a reading against them.

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child scores two readings with the checklist.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kasi ifaayo ya kusoma ni ipi?" Kwa nini "Haraka iwezekanavyo" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kusoma kwa ufasaha si kusoma haraka sana. Kasi ifaayo ni ya wastani, ili msikilizaji aelewe kila neno.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Sauti ipasavyo wakati wa kusoma ni ipi?" Kwa nini "Kupiga kelele" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Sauti ipasavyo ni ile inayosikika wazi bila kupiga kelele wala kunong'ona.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ukifika kwenye koma wakati wa kusoma, ufanye nini?" Kwa nini "Niendelee bila kupumzika" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Alama za uakifishi zinatuonyesha mahali pa kupumzika: kidogo kwenye koma na kwa muda mrefu zaidi kwenye kikomo.
Msomaji mzuri huwaangalia wasikilizaji mara kwa mara.

checks.question: Taja vipengele vitatu vya kusoma kwa ufasaha.
checks.answer: matamshi bora, kasi ifaayo, sauti ifaayo

checks.question: Kusoma kwa sauti ya juu sana ni ufasaha?

skills.key_step: The child reads a phrase as one breath, lets the marks set the pauses and the voice, and checks the listener understood.

floor.prerequisite: Reads short words with every sound clear.
floor.question: Soma: "Mama anapika."

representations: a recording of the child played back
steps: Ask a listener one question about it.
contexts: reading a story to a younger sibling

board.do: Je, umewahi kuvaa hereni za dhahabu?
Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child reads the sentence aloud twice: once as a statement, once as the question.

listen_for: Bibi ... alivaa ... shanga ... nyekundu ... na ... bangili ... za ... fedha.
misconceptions.ask: Ukisoma neno moja moja, msikilizaji anaelewa sentensi?
misconceptions.repair: Usomaji wa ufasaha husoma kundi la maneno kwa pamoja, kama tunavyozungumza.

misconceptions.ask: Wasikilizaji waliweza kuelewa uliposoma haraka hivyo?
misconceptions.repair: Kasi ifaayo ni ile ya kuzungumza: si haraka mno, si polepole mno.

listen_for: kwa sauti ileile ya sentensi ya kawaida
misconceptions.ask: Alama iliyo mwishoni mwa sentensi hii ni ipi?
misconceptions.repair: Kiulizi (?) hupandisha sauti mwishoni; alama ya hisi (!) huonyesha hisia.

listen_for: hapana mahali, unasoma moja kwa moja
misconceptions.repair: Simama kidogo kwenye koma, na zaidi kwenye kikomo.

misconceptions.ask: Sikiliza tofauti kati ya maneno haya mawili. Yanatofautiana wapi?
misconceptions.repair: Tamka "hereni" kama lilivyoandikwa; "heleni" ni neno jingine au si neno.

checks.question: Sentensi "Lo, kanga yako inapendeza mno!" inasomwa kwa hisia kwa sababu ya alama ipi?
Kasi ifaayo ya kusoma ni ipi?
